item.title: Narrated Product Videos Without a Video File: a Canvas, JavaScript and a Free Voice-Over
item.description: A video that is a web page: frames drawn in JavaScript, a free synthetic voice, an agent doing the heavy lifting. The method, every free TTS option worth knowing (and which ones you are actually allowed to publish), and a step-by-step example you can watch right here.
